audience: HR and people teams that keep employee records, work schedules and time off in flex

useCases.title: Look up employees and their departments
useCases.text: Get employees by employee number, with their department and job title on a date. List departments and cost centers for reference.

useCases.title: Check joins, leaves and transfers
useCases.text: List the employees whose HR data changed on a date. Then read their current records.

useCases.title: Compare planned work with clock events
useCases.text: Read planned work and time-off blocks for up to 31 days. Compare them with the clock-in and clock-out events of the same period.

useCases.title: Review time off and leave of absence
useCases.text: List the time off that employees used in a period and their annual leave grants. Check who is on leave of absence now.

useCases.title: Find public and company holidays
useCases.text: List the public and company holidays between two dates, up to 366 days.

useCases.title: Check department heads and job codes
useCases.text: List the current heads of the departments you choose. List job roles, positions, titles and ranks.
